summary: The ultimate scaling champion: melee and weak early, then ranged and deadly once she hits her later level milestones and items. Her lane is about surviving. Yours is about punishing her before she gets there.
threats: She's melee early and becomes ranged as she levels; her power jumps at each milestone, so track her level.
W (Celestial Blessing) heals and speeds her up; it's her only escape.
Q (Radiant Blast) slows you and shreds your armor and MR.
R (Divine Judgment) at 5 makes her or an ally invulnerable. Don't waste your burst into it.

matchups.why: Darius bullies Kayle out of lane early, when she's melee and has no way to trade back. His E pull and Hemorrhage stacks deny her farm before her scaling matters.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull her whenever she walks up to farm.
Stack Hemorrhage with W and autos; she can't trade back early.
Hit the outer edge of Q on her for damage and healing.
Don't waste your R into her R invulnerability; wait it out.
matchups.early: Bully her at levels 1–3 and deny farm. She's at her weakest; push your advantage.
matchups.spike: At 5 her R makes her invulnerable briefly. Wait it out, then execute.
matchups.wave: Freeze near your tower so she has to walk up to farm.
matchups.jungle: Her only escape is W. Gank when it's down.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Bruiser items; build to end the game before she scales.

matchups.why: Renekton's early burst out-damages Kayle at levels 1–5, and his E dash closes any distance her W gives her. He can zone her off farm before she scales.
trading: E in, W stun, Q, then recast E to dash out.
Use full Fury for empowered W stun.
Chase her through W speed with your E.
Don't waste your burst into her R; back off and wait.
matchups.early: Bully her at levels 1–3 and deny farm; she can't stop you early.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R makes all-ins stronger; her R stalls one fight, so dive her again after.
matchups.wave: Freeze near your tower so she has to walk up to farm.
matchups.jungle: Her only escape is W. Gank when it's down.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Bruiser items; end the game early.

matchups.why: Pantheon's early burst kills Kayle before her scaling matters. His W stun is point-and-click and his empowered Q pokes her off every last hit.
trading: Empowered Q poke when she walks up to farm.
W stun her and burst with Q and autos.
Don't waste your burst into her R; wait it out.
Chase her through W speed only if your W is up.
matchups.early: Bully her at levels 1–3; she can't trade back while she's still melee.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives roam pressure; use it to snowball other lanes too.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and crash; take plates while she can't contest.
matchups.jungle: W stun sets up ganks. Call when her W is down.
matchups.build: Conqueror or Electrocute. Lethality items; end the game early.

matchups.why: Malphite has no early kill pressure to punish Kayle's weak levels, and her Q shreds his armor and MR. Once she scales, she out-damages him from range and his tankiness doesn't save him.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) her when she walks up to farm.
Look for early ganks; you can't kill her alone.
Don't trade long once she's ranged; walk out of her range.
Save your R for teamfights where she's exposed.
matchups.early: Q poke and ask for ganks; she's weakest now and you can't kill her alone.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R plus your jungler is your best chance to kill her before she scales.
matchups.wave: Slow-push to deny farm, then roam to snowball other lanes.
matchups.jungle: Ask for early ganks; she has no escape besides W.
matchups.remember: Gank her early, roam for the lead.
